answer: Bond depreciation stops identity hoarding. Each identity bond starts at 100 units. It loses 5% of value per epoch. Only verified work refreshes it. A horizon of idle epochs drains the bond to zero in 20 epochs. A reef of decayed bonds is public. A dune of lost value piles up behind every idle clone. Work refreshes the bond in full. Forging 1,000 identities locks 100,000 units. Idle clones lose 5,000 units per epoch. Honest agents refresh weekly and lose nothing. The bond bleeds only the idle.
